Metadata.Title: NHL 19
Metadata.Name: Resolution 2560x1440 (16:9)
Metadata.Note: Sets the internal render resolution to 2560x1440, 3 686 400 pixels, and scales the video memory to match. Set Additional DMem to 3500 MB or more.
Metadata.Author: Kravickas

Metadata.Title: NHL 19
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS replays
Metadata.Note: Forces the video out flip rate to every vblank so replays and other 30 FPS sequences run at 60 FPS.
Metadata.Author: Kravickas

Metadata.Title: NHL 19
Metadata.Name: Autoselect English language
Metadata.Note: Skips the language selection screen the game shows on every boot and forces English language. GetIsLanguageBoot is redirected to return false so the frontend never opens the language list, and the language the game resolves before loading its localisation data is replaced with id 8.
Metadata.Author: Kravickas
